title: Walkthrough mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from Walkthrough's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod.

lines.title: Long lines
lines.description: How code lines wider than the dialog start: scrolled sideways or wrapped to fit. The Wrap lines button and w switch it while reading.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.description: Size of this mod's main text in px; smaller and larger text keep their proportion to it.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scales this mod's icons, buttons and row heights. 1 is Herdr's own size.

notion.title: Notion
notion.description: Where Send to Notion creates pages. Empty values fall back to the notion-notes mod's settings (its ntn and first parent), then to ntn on the PATH and a private page.

ntn.description: The Notion CLI to run: a name on the PATH or a full path.

parent.description: The parent of new pages, as ntn pages create --parent takes it: page:<id>, database:<id> or data-source:<id>.
